code:
Table: sys_security_acl

Every ACL record, however it was created,
lives here. No separate permission engine.
Query this table to see every access rule
governing the instance.
caption: One table governs every access rule on the platform.

code:
3 ACLs apply to a read attempt:
  ACL 1 (role check)      -> PASS
  ACL 2 (script condition) -> PASS
  ACL 3 (field script)     -> FAIL

Result: ACCESS DENIED

Every applicable ACL must pass.
One failure blocks the whole operation.
caption: The rule almost every new admin assumes works backwards.
